Project.title: Project
Project.description: Learning material or game project created by a teacher

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher owning this project

content.description: JSON object holding template-specific content data

mediaRefs.description: Mapping from media ID to Cloudinary or public media URL

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the project was last updated

isPublic.description: Whether the project is shared publicly for students via link

/projects/{projectId}.description: Collection of projects created by teachers
